dedupe_keys.name: ida ice indoor climate and energy

description: IDA ICE is EQUA's whole-year, detailed and dynamic multi-zone simulation application for thermal indoor climate and the energy use of a whole building, modelling the building, its systems and controllers. EQUA says its physical models reflect current research and that results compare well with measured data, and it adapts the software to local languages, climate data, standards, systems, reports and product data. Models are equation based, written in the Modelica-like Neutral Model Format (NMF), solved with a general-purpose variable time step solver; every equation can be browsed and about a thousand variables per zone can be logged. BIM import covers IFC and common 2D and 3D CAD files, a version handling system reruns dependent cases, and since version 4.8 parametric optimisation of properties such as window data or collector size has been possible, now with cloud high-performance computing. IDA ICE 5 focuses on indoor climate prediction, the building as an energy prosumer, and cloud optimisation. The same company offers IDA Districts for district energy systems and IDA Tunnel for tunnel ventilation and fire. Coverage: generic. Access: licensed from EQUA, with brochures and training. Licence: commercial. Caveats: proprietary, and NMF components are specific to the IDA environment. Simulation uses: indoor climate and energy studies, HVAC sizing, retrofit optimisation and overheating assessment under future weather files. Related records: EnergyPlus, the Modelica Buildings library and TRNSYS.
